title: Polish Sausage and Crumble Italian Hash
description: A hearty Italian-inspired hash made with Polish sausage, crumble, and a hint of umami.
instructions: Slice the Polish sausage into 1-inch pieces.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the crumble and Norwegian crumble to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the crumble is lightly toasted.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 5-7 minutes, until the sausage is cooked through.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with umami powder.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
